title: Export View My Courses from Workday.
lead: The parser needs the Excel Workday gives you from View My Courses — not a screenshot and not a PDF.
step1b: Sign in and go to Academics → View My Courses.
step2b: Use the spreadsheet export. Keep .xlsx or .xls.
step3b: Use Import Excel. Columns are read by header name: Course Listing, Section, Registration Status, Meeting Patterns, Instructor, and dates.
step4: Choose what goes on the grid
step4b: Nothing is placed automatically. Check Active courses, add Waitlist as dashed boxes, and leave Dropped off unless you need them.
note: Labs with a blank meeting pattern stay in the list so you can add a time.
seoDescription: How to export UBC Workday View My Courses Excel and build a weekly timetable locally.
